digest.component_or_area: workflow gates (plan review and completion verification)
propositions: Ticket descriptions exceeding 8,000 characters must block both plan-review and completion-verification gates before any LLM call or context assembly.
Plan review returns deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false; completion verification returns deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when description size exceeds the configured maximum.
The 8,000-character limit is configurable through typed [verify] configuration with a default value, and exactly 8,000 characters is admitted while 8,001 blocks.
Light-bug review must retain P4 description blocks in det_blocking while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory, then flow into the shared deterministic short circuit.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; P4 emits at most one oversize finding combining all size criteria.
